description: Status of a writ_website_to_api build. wait=true is one held call (up to 75 s) that follows the build to its newest rung and returns when it is done or parked. Answers: succeeded (workflow_id, functions, run_example), failed, cancelled, or needs_guidance (the build is the caller's to finish with writ_website_to_api mode=guided build_id=<id>; its map comes with it).

wait.description: One held call until done or parked.

name: writ_discovery_status
title: Check an API build
